rules.name: Empty reply
rules.note: The model sent nothing back. Usually a crash, a timeout or a stop string hit at once.

rules.name: Reply starts with OOC
rules.note: The model stepped out of the story. Fine if the player asked an OOC question; a problem otherwise.

rules.name: Model speaks as the AI
rules.note: Breaks immersion in any roleplay card.
